newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: FCL Paper eyes greater ANM stake.
newsitem.headline: FCL Paper eyes greater ANM stake.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Paper said on Thursday it had submitted a notice to the Australian Foreign Investment Review Board in respect of its potential interest in increasing its ownership of Australian Newsprint Mills (ANM).
Fletcher Challenge Paper currently holds 50 percent of ANM.

"Earlier this year News Limited indicated that it was reviewing opportunities that could involve the divestment of its own 50 percent shareholding," FCL Paper said in a statement to the New Zealand Stock Exchange.
"News Limited has conducted discussions with a number of parties including Fletcher Challenge Paper. The parties have agreed that they will not comment on the status of those discussions," it said.
